name: cli-transcriber
description: Skills and agents written once as YAML with shared partials: a skill that keeps the agent editing the sources, not the generated files.

interface.shortDescription: Skills from YAML with shared partials, checked
interface.longDescription: Skills and agents are written once as YAML; shared text lives in partials with parameters. The build checks that every partial, skill, agent and tool a source uses exists and is declared, and writes Markdown for Claude Code, Codex or a plugin. The skill keeps the agent editing the sources and running the build.
defaultPrompt: Move the text these two skills share into a partial.
Add a skill for code review that uses our report partial.
Run the transcriber check and fix what it reports.
